about: A Python framework for building AI programs from language model calls instead of hand-written prompts.

prs.title: Tools with dates or set choices as defaults work again
prs.broken: Programs can give the AI model tools to call. If a tool had a default value like a date or a choice from a fixed list, calling the model crashed with an error.
prs.changed: Those default values are now turned into plain text the model's interface understands, like 2026-01-02 for a date.
prs.matters: Tools with ordinary defaults just work, without people rewriting them to avoid the crash.
